claims.statement_en: The chapter introduction describes the surah as Medinan.
The chapter introduction also reports an unnamed Meccan classification.

claims.voice_position: Anas ibn Malik / Prophetic report transmitted through Ahmad and Muslim routes
claims.statement_en: A report presents the surah as newly revealed during a brief doze and explains al-Kawthar as a river granted in Paradise, associated with abundant good and a pool visited by the community.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: هو نهر أعطانيه ربي عز وجل في الجنة عليه خير كثير ... هو حوض ترد عليه أمتي

claims.voice_position: Ibn Kathir / legal and recitational inferences reported
claims.statement_en: He notes that many readers infer a Medinan setting from the report and that many jurists infer that the basmala belongs to and was revealed with the surah.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: استدل به كثير من القراء ... وكثير من الفقهاء على أن البسملة من السورة
claims.translation_scope: Corresponding bounded passage in stored abridged English; no global edition absence inferred.

claims.voice_position: Ibn Abbas: good/abundant-good gloss; Sa'id ibn Jubayr: river-within-good reply to Abu Bishr
claims.statement_en: Ibn Abbas explains al-Kawthar as the good, also worded abundant good, given to the Prophet; Sa'id ibn Jubayr separately clarifies that the river in Paradise is part of that good.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: عن سعيد بن جبير عن ابن عباس ... هو الخير الذي أعطاه الله إياه ... النهر الذي في الجنة من الخير الذي أعطاه الله إياه ... الكوثر الخير الكثير
claims.translation_state: core interpretation aligned in abridged English; printed Arabic routes are abridged
claims.evidence_state: arabic route and bounded English context verified

claims.statement_en: The command is connected with prayer to the Lord and the slaughter of sacrificial camels.

claims.voice_position: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Said ibn Jubayr, and Qatada report
claims.statement_en: A named report cluster identifies the hostile referent as al-As ibn Wa'il.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: قال ابن عباس ومجاهد وسعيد بن جبير وقتادة نزلت في العاص بن وائل

claims.statement_en: The hater of Muhammad and of the guidance he brought is called the lesser, humiliated one whose remembrance is cut off.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: إن مبغضك ... هو الأبتر الأقل الأذل المنقطع ذكره
